items.detail: Write Yokai of the Week into the show's rules as a standing Wednesday feature (one new yokai each week: the folklore, how it could work in your game, a sweet-spooky moment), instead of a weekly tuning setting.
items.title: Make Yokai of the Week permanent

items.detail: Each Friday, one small Godot step (about an hour) towards a working radish monster: counter, spawn, chase, tiers, game over. The game notebook tracks which steps you've done, and the next step builds on it.
items.title: Radish build-along

items.detail: Quick buttons on the answer page for the Retro Game of the Week and the Actress of the Month film (Played or Watched, then Liked, Mixed or Disliked), so the picks learn your taste without you having to write anything.
items.title: Played it / Watched it buttons

summary: You scored lore, chat and the workshop highest this week (the workshop climbed from 3 to 5 once it went hands-on), liked 159 stories with just one dislike, and almost every answer was about your game and yokai. So the show keeps lore full, keeps the workshop practical, builds the chat and game tech around your own game ideas, and trims procedural politics to a line.
